evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive sets cadence by positional authority; the aphoristic justification supplies a logical warrant for the mandate.
Assertive restatement of the mandated cadence, reinforcing the positional directive without new justification.
Self-assignment of ownership asserts positional authority over the rehearsal process.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityYouDoNotHave
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being warranted by equating unrehearsed capability with absence of capability?
